_about: Offline relevance eval for /search (CURRENT.md Phase 2). Profiles are generated from expertise archetypes with a fixed seed; queries are hand-written client briefs. A profile's relevance to a query is the grade its archetype has in `relevant` (2 core fit, 1 adjacent, else 0). Labels are topical: they ignore budget, rating and seniority.

queries.query: Need a web dashboard for our logistics startup: data tables, charts and user roles. Modern React stack preferred.
We want an iPhone and Android app for booking yoga classes with push notifications, ideally from one codebase.
Our AWS bill is out of control and deploys are manual. Looking for someone to containerise our services and set up proper pipelines.
Build a support assistant that answers customer questions from our help-center articles.
Python API for a multi-tenant SaaS with Postgres, background jobs and good test coverage.
Need pipelines that pull data from Salesforce, HubSpot and Stripe into our warehouse, refreshed hourly.
Detect scratches and dents in car photos uploaded by insurance customers.
Redesign our onboarding flow; we need user research and clickable prototypes before development starts.
Penetration test our web app and help us get ready for a SOC 2 audit.
Set up a Shopify store with subscriptions and migrate our products over from WooCommerce.
Telehealth backend: patient scheduling and visit records. It must handle PHI under HIPAA.
Automated end-to-end tests for our checkout so broken releases stop reaching production.
GraphQL API in TypeScript for our marketplace, with realtime notifications.
Executive KPI dashboards on top of our sales database, with churn and retention views.
Write and audit an ERC-20 token and a staking contract.
Card payments, payouts and a double-entry ledger for our lending product.
Customer portal in Vue with a booking widget we can embed on partner websites.
Casual mobile puzzle game with in-app purchases.
Semantic search over thousands of legal contracts so lawyers can ask questions in plain English.
Our Kubernetes clusters keep falling over during traffic spikes; we need autoscaling and alerting.
